probe_detail.name: Sets up an expectation and then turns it
Extent of capitalised or shouted typography
Trailing furniture: hashtags, handles, parenthetical byline
A specific concrete detail carries the joke

final.name: Vocabulary pins the entry to a specific moment in time
final.audit_justification: Explicitly disclaimed as not a quality judgement; measures whether vocabulary reveals the item's temporal period, a datedness fingerprint rather than craft.
final.upstream_parent: Where this contest falls in the long run of contests (calendar position of the container)

final.name: Marks itself as an addition to an existing pile
final.audit_justification: Explicitly disclaimed as not a quality judgement; measures explicit series/continuation phrasing, a boilerplate marker that could also flag a prolific, practiced entrant.
final.upstream_parent: How many entries already exist in the container, and how many the same author has already submitted

final.name: Extent of length and long-word, long-clause complexity
final.audit_justification: Explicit counting task over length, readability, and capitalisation with an explicit non-evaluation instruction; pure formatting/length signal.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Original angle within the prompt

final.name: Extent of text bulk and capitalised emphasis
final.audit_justification: Counting task over length and capitalisation proportion, explicitly disclaimed as not a quality judgement.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Memorable compact image or phrase

final.name: Distance of the angle from the prompt's stock associations
final.audit_justification: Evaluates originality of the comic angle relative to obvious associations, rewarding unexpected connections and penalising restatement -- a content/craft judgement.

final.name: Extent of length, capitals, and mention count
final.audit_justification: Counting task over length, capitals, and mention count, explicitly disclaimed as not evaluative.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Surprising turn

final.name: Extent of clause count and sentence-length variation
final.audit_justification: Counting task over length, clause count, and capitalisation, explicitly disclaimed as not evaluative.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Rhythm supports the payoff

final.name: Extent of capitals, length, and hashtag count
final.audit_justification: Counting task over capitals, length, and hashtag count, explicitly disclaimed as not evaluative.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Observation has recognizable truth

final.name: Speaker made legible by word choice, not styling
final.audit_justification: Measures whether diction and stance make a speaker/persona legible, a voice/characterisation craft judgement, explicitly excluding typography.

final.name: New meaning created by the alteration
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a wordplay alteration produces genuine new meaning against the prompt -- a craft/content judgement.

final.name: Every word load-bearing for the comic idea
final.audit_justification: Measures density of load-bearing words for the comic idea, an editing/economy craft judgement independent of raw length.

final.name: Reads as a first, most obvious reading of the prompt
final.audit_justification: Explicitly disclaimed as not a quality judgement, estimating position on an obvious-to-oblique axis without reward either way, though the practice/exposure behind oblique readings could also yield genuinely better entries.
final.upstream_parent: How early the entry was written relative to its sibling entries in the same contest

final.name: Extent of overall length, mentions, and capitals
final.audit_justification: Counting task over length, mentions, and capitals, explicitly disclaimed as not evaluative ('brevity is not virtue here').
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Economical wording

final.name: Specific comic attitude carried by word choice alone
final.audit_justification: Evaluates whether word choice alone conveys a specific comic attitude that supports the idea -- a tonal craft judgement, explicitly excluding typography.

final.name: Extent of length, mention count, and capitals
final.audit_justification: Counting task over length, mentions, and capitals, explicitly disclaimed as not evaluative.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Transformation changes the meaning

final.name: Extent of capitalised and elongated emphasis markers
final.audit_justification: Counting task over capitalisation, length, and elongated emphasis spellings, explicitly disclaimed as not evaluative.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Emotional attitude is legible

final.name: Cadence functionally timed to the final beat
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether word arrangement functionally times the comic beat -- a rhythm/craft judgement, explicitly excluding length and typography.

final.name: Observational accuracy about a real shared behaviour
final.audit_justification: Evaluates accuracy and specificity of an observational claim in the context of the prompt -- a content judgement, explicitly excluding formatting.

final.name: Recallable formulation judged independent of length or typography
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether the entry contains a memorable, reproducible formulation -- a craft judgement, explicitly independent of length or typography.

final.name: Presupposes a shared running joke or prior entries
final.audit_justification: Explicitly disclaimed as not a quality judgement; measures dependence on assumed shared/in-group context, which could also flag an embedded, practiced community member who writes better entries.
final.upstream_parent: How late the entry sits in the container, and how many sibling entries preceded it

final.name: Genuine redirection of an established expectation
final.audit_justification: Evaluates genuine setup-to-turn redirection with a retrospectively sensible payoff -- core joke-mechanics craft judgement.

final.name: Extent of shouted capitals and elaborated sentence length
final.audit_justification: Counting task over capitalisation, length, and sentence-construction readability, explicitly disclaimed as not evaluative.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Character voice is implied

final.name: Uses contest-community conventions, formats, or meta-references
final.audit_justification: Explicitly disclaimed as not a quality judgement; measures use of community-specific conventions/formats, which could also flag an experienced, practiced contest participant.
final.upstream_parent: How deep into the long run of contests the container sits, and how established the author is within it
